units.rawText: —Unless the signal jamming was just a byproduct of the barrier's true effect, which is targeted at the Entropics!

units.rawText: It's at (α 46.32,  β 65.91, γ24,35). According to the CCTV feed earlier, there doesn't seem to be many Entropics there.

units.rawText: I know how to operate the Weather Simulator. I can support you with natural disasters.

units.rawText: So one group goes to the Admin Center to fight, while the other group goes to operate the Weather Simulator... Splitting up is a good idea.

units.rawText: Sol is the best fighter among us, so she should go to the Admin Center with you. I'll be fine. The Entropics aren't targeting the Weather Simulator yet, so you don't need to worry about me.

units.rawText: Professor...

units.rawText: ...Thank you for your trust.
units.displayText: ...Thank you for your trust.

spans.text: ...Thank you for your trust.

units.rawText: While I'm none too happy about having to leave you so soon... Since it's part of your plan, there must be some logic to it, Professor!
